title: Get a licence for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's licence before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

laws.title: Shire of Menzies Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2022

sources.title: Shire of Menzies Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2022

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.

assessment.summary: Advertising signs in public places need the council's licence.
